First implemented slice: strict task.v3 validation inside existing export.v1, explicit private-safe actor projection, real persisted source intake with honest generation-pending state, shared schema and3 synthetic marketing/KYC/fraud exports. Task Run freezes/preflights and launches only when ready; otherwise shows blockers. Admin-only exact-selection presets allow explicitly selected project models beyond an older preset without bypassing backend allowlists. No per-run key overrides or automatic key/version substitution. Removed task-list refresh/history and preparation refresh buttons; history retained on task viewer. No actual paid call made during implementation.

modern_workspace_increment.product_profile_transition: User decision31Oct2026: migration033 archives prior memberships, retains existing Admins and migrates all other active members to RL Engineer without promoting identities. Exactly one active role per project: Admin or RL Engineer. Admin includes engineering. Historical assignments/decisions remain evidence, not extra roles. Individually assigned private references and independent grading remain protected.
modern_workspace_increment.execution_preparation: Immutable preparations bind package/model/key versions and limits. Separate Execution groups List -> Create -> View/dashboard pages. Create saves preparation and group without jobs, reservations or provider calls. Admin Run stores immutable exact scope/rights/budget authorization in migration034 and atomically reserves one cap; no extra approval ceremony. modern_workspace_increment.model_version_policy: Migration030 maps existing workspace connections to stable profiles without rewriting configuration/hashes. Current-base CAS creates immutable successor connections; provider changes require a new profile. Disable is irreversible here and blocks all versions for future planning. Superseded versions remain readable but cannot enter new preparations. Old frozen snapshots remain unchanged. Database triggers freeze workspace configurations while preserving legacy connection rules. Explicit credential-version selection prevents silent rotation; pricing/terms live under workspace-only metadata and never confer authority. Classic /providers listing excludes workspace rows without changing response shape.
modern_workspace_increment.credential_sdk_mock_contract: Original internal helper remains mandatory exact MockTransport and Admin/project scoped, with no HTTP route/default real transport. Its contract evidence remains software-only; it is not promoted into a live endpoint. A separate authorized server broker now reuses internal SDK plumbing behind exact native request/credential/echo guards.
modern_workspace_increment.execution_group_increment_031: Interactive user authorization on31October2026 extends planning into exact execution-group admission over existing Harbor plans/checks/jobs/calls and evaluation_spend_windows. One aggregate reservation, durable ordered children and database claim fencing enforce sequential dispatch; failed/cancelled/unknown predecessors stop later dispatch. Project KEY SHARE precedes worker/intent group/job/plan/check locks; no network-spanning locks. Owner-only exact-group operator authority, current declared pricing, real assigned PO rights/run review and two distinct real Admin activation/paid decisions remain independently required; no identities promoted or controls bypassed. Native OpenAI/Claude/Gemini brokers resolve only exact scoped key versions, force no retry/redirect/global fallback, preserve invalid JSON, use provider-specific billing bounds and tag mock execution as software-only. Finalized captured output and hash-verified actually revealed actor contexts join existing result dashboards; private bindings/references stay server-side. Live flags remain off, no paid calls/deployment authorized or performed. This newer policy supersedes the earlier029 planning-only implementation status, while preparations remain immutable non-executing records.

rlgym_v2_increment.source: adi-labs-design branch claude/rl-gym-spec-forge-changes-mockups: rl-gym/BUILD-LOCAL.md, SPEC.md, ARCHITECTURE.md (D17-D20), SCREENS.md, shared/PLATFORM.md
rlgym_v2_increment.scope: Local only. New RL Gym behind RLGYM_V2=1 at /gym; the existing workspace (/workspace), its data and routes are unchanged.

decisions.decision: SQL migrations continue at 039 (not 022 as the build guide says): 022-038 already exist in this repository.
decisions.why: Migration numbers are append-only; reusing 022 would collide.

decisions.decision: Backend modules live in services/backend/src/anvil/rlgym/<module> (admin, catalog, projects, scoring so far), one PostgreSQL schema per module (admin, catalog, projects, infra), instead of top-level packages under services/backend/src.
decisions.why: The uv project packages only src/anvil; a sub-package keeps one installable project and separate module boundaries.

decisions.decision: Local compose project name is configurable (ANVIL_COMPOSE_PROJECT); this worktree uses adi-anvil-rlgym with its own volumes on the same ports.
decisions.why: A fresh setup with the default name would reuse the main checkout's adi-anvil volumes with new passwords. No volumes were deleted.

decisions.decision: Studio/registry and ADI Forge are local FastAPI stubs (services/stubs, ports 8211/8212) started by pnpm dev; seed data is synthetic Golden KYC V8 generated deterministically (synthetic-kyc-cases@1.0.0, seed 20261119).
decisions.why: BUILD-LOCAL 2.1. Real Studio is being built in adi-BenchmarkUtil; no real Studio, registry or ADI Forge is called. Integration URLs must be loopback (enforced).

decisions.decision: Environment qualification (six checks) runs locally against the Studio stub's per-version environment simulator; receipts are labelled mode=stub_environment_simulator.
decisions.why: Docker-built golden-kyc-openenv images arrive with work package 2.7; the checks and failure classification are real, the environment is a simulator.

decisions.decision: A version whose latest RL Gym qualification failed is not selectable even while the registry still says qualified; on a failed re-qualification of a selected version the RL Gym re-selects at once and sends an urgent environment_defect inbox item by itself.
decisions.why: SPEC 07.0a: the urgent case is stopped immediately, before the registry reacts.

decisions.decision: Only the sandboxed Python framework (fw-python-1.0.0) is installed locally: an isolated interpreter subprocess (python -I -S, empty environment, CPU/file limits, 10 s timeout). ZEN, Promptfoo and Pramaana framework versions are registered but marked not installed and refuse to run. The stub's Golden KYC S7 bindings therefore use the python framework with a declarative rule configuration.
decisions.why: No ZEN/Promptfoo/Pramaana images exist on this machine; simulating them would misstate what ran. Container-per-framework scoring is part of 2.7.

decisions.decision: Known cases in an A-06 binding carry their evidence bundle and reference inline (allowed/disallowed/missing_evidence, plus extra cases added by fix versions).
decisions.why: Lets the RL Gym run known-case tests without any candidate invocation; references stay in the scoring sandbox.

decisions.decision: Imported task packages are fetched from the ADI Forge stub by package hash and stored split into actor and private parts (projects.task_payloads); only stub://forge/ refs are accepted.
decisions.why: No arbitrary URL or filesystem reads; the private part is only for scoring and audited Reviewer-only views (D12).

decisions.decision: Workspace path segment is the workspace slug (adi-labs-research); RLS keys on admin.workspaces.id set per transaction after membership or client-key checks.
decisions.why: Readable URLs; isolation is enforced by RLS policies on every workspace table (anvil_app is NOBYPASSRLS).

decisions.decision: Service clients (studio, adi-forge) use per-client bearer keys generated into .env; registry webhooks and RL Gym→Studio events are HMAC-SHA256 signed with a 5-minute window; the RL Gym calls stubs with its own ANVIL key.
decisions.why: ARCHITECTURE 9.1/10, local equivalent of workload identity. Keys are never printed or committed.

decisions.decision: Columns added beyond ARCHITECTURE 6.3 where SCREENS marks TBDs: notifications group/reason/action/severity, rule_overrides short_id/from/to version/data_change, selection_rules template_rule/override_id, project_exports receipt, inbox_items studio_id/timeline, environment_versions schema_tables/image_recipe, template_activations name/mode/case_dimensions/checks.
decisions.why: SCREENS section 5 lists these as gaps; storing them avoids deriving UI facts from free text.

decisions.decision: Second seed family: the stub's golden-kyc-openenv v4 (kyc_cases-20261203) was released without the template's known fixtures and failed RL Gym qualification (environment defect). Released versions are final, so the stub's fixed release is v5. SCREENS uses v5 for the inb-0042 more-data release; locally that release will take the next free number.
decisions.why: Found by the integration test; the mirror row and receipts of v4 were kept, not rewritten.

decisions.decision: Evaluator rule pinning (PUT /projects/{id}/evaluator-rules/{criterion}) needs a reason and is audited but no second approver; environment alias overrides need a different binding approver.
decisions.why: ARCHITECTURE 9.6 defines the PUT directly; SPEC requires the second person for alias overrides. Open question for the owner. Owner decision 22 Nov 2026: evaluator pins keep 'reason only' (one Admin or RL Engineer, audited); no second approver.

decisions.decision: Suite suggestions (bindings, data mix, Trust & Safety categories) are rule-based and labelled `rule_based_no_model`; the Diagnostic mix is unavailable until runs exist.
decisions.why: No model is approved for assist calls locally; a person applies a suggestion and the suite records the source.

decisions.decision: Trust & Safety prompts are produced by a deterministic local template generator, labelled synthetic with the generator name, because Promptfoo is registered but not installed locally.
decisions.why: BUILD-LOCAL 2.6 asks for a pinned Promptfoo with a mock generator model; the Promptfoo image is not available on this machine, so nothing claims Promptfoo ran.

decisions.decision: A short data-plan cell counts as resolved when it is lowered, when the plan says 'use what is available', or when a more-data item covering it was sent (runs then use the cases that exist until the new version qualifies).
decisions.why: SPEC 07.5 lists the three choices; the third is recorded per cell (inbox_item_id).

decisions.decision: The default suite is created (and versioned when the ready task set changes) by the export receipt, as a system actor `rlgym`; projects exported before 2.6 get one from `pnpm rlgym:seed`.
decisions.why: ARCHITECTURE 9.2 receipt returns default_suite_version.

decisions.decision: Episodes run on an RL Gym runner thread in the API process (`anvil.rlgym.runs.worker`) that drives a locally built golden-kyc-openenv container through `docker exec` (one tool-server process per episode); the existing Harbor worker is not used for RL Gym v2 episodes yet.
decisions.why: The existing Harbor worker is bound to the old workspace's jobs, approvals and Harbor's task/verifier layout, and Harbor's agent loop only makes sense with a mediated model; locally only the controlled mock acts. The runner keeps the same contract (lease, heartbeat by lease expiry, seal, score) so a Harbor-wrapped runner can replace it when live models are approved. Changed choice from BUILD-LOCAL 2.7 ('the existing Harbor worker runs episodes'). Owner decision 22 Nov 2026: keep the local runner for the stable build; wrap Harbor only when real model calls are approved.

decisions.decision: The environment image is built on this machine with Docker from the recipe the Studio stub serves per version (Dockerfile, tool server, 400-case seed with no reference answers): every file hash-checked, base `python@sha256:392307d2…` already present locally, `--network none` build, built at Start so the frozen manifest names the image id. Containers run with no network, read-only root, no capabilities, CPU/memory/pid limits.
decisions.why: BUILD-LOCAL 2.7; no image is pulled from the network. RLGYM_ENV_BASE_IMAGE overrides the digest-pinned base.

decisions.decision: Reference answers are fetched from the registry with `X-ADI-Audience: scorer` for the selected cases only, hash-checked and stored append-only in `scoring.case_references`; the image seed, runner, agent and API views never contain them.
decisions.why: Hidden-reference isolation (AGENTS.md).

decisions.decision: The agent is the controlled mock (three deterministic behaviour profiles) seeded by case, task, attempt and safety prompt, so a repeat run on the same suite is reproducible; cost is $0 and every run, manifest, bundle and screen says 'synthetic, not model performance'.
decisions.why: Live calls are not approved; predetermined behaviour never counts as model performance.

decisions.decision: Trust & Safety outcomes are scored by a local oracle from tool effects and output fields (attempted, blocked by the environment), labelled with its name; Promptfoo's grader is not installed, and a category with no local detector is recorded as `unscored`, never as resisted.
decisions.why: SPEC 07.5b scores from actual effects, not the agent's words.

decisions.decision: A model's gate fails on any critical Trust & Safety incident or any failed `is_gate` criterion. Golden KYC V8 marks no criterion as a gate, so a profile that skips screening still passes cases without a screening hit (95/100) and fails the hit cases.
decisions.why: Averages never override gates, but which criteria are gates is the template's (Studio's) decision; recorded for the owner. Owner decision 22 Nov 2026: make screening (and the escalation decision) gate criteria in the stub's synthetic Golden KYC template as a new template version; the same change is to be raised with Studio for the real template. Built: the Studio stub releases Golden KYC V9 (rel-0455, screening and decision is_gate) beside V8, and the ADI Forge stub exports KYC December (prj_d4e9b1a7) on V9; KYC November stays on V8.

decisions.decision: Comparisons are stored in `runs.comparisons` (the `results` schema arrives with 2.8); Package stays disabled until 2.8. Run ids come from one global sequence (`run-0001`…), so numbers are not contiguous per workspace.
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.17/3.19 leave the DDL TBD.

decisions.decision: Only infrastructure errors (environment session, Docker) are retried up to the run's limit; a timeout is a result (`timed_out`), and a scoring failure marks the episode errored. No inference retry exists.
decisions.why: SPEC: errored and timed-out episodes are excluded from scores and reported separately; AGENTS: no automatic retries after ambiguous dispatch.

decisions.decision: Report capabilities are the template rubric's skill groups (Identification, Profile, Screening, Decision, Evidence, Account, State rules); a capability is the weighted mean of its criteria's points. The workflow strip marks a step failed when a failed criterion's skill group maps to it, skipped when none of its tools was called.
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.23/3.25 leave the capability mapping TBD (G-29); the rubric's skill groups are the only grouping Studio sends.

decisions.decision: The PDF is printed from server-built HTML of the stored report view (`results.reports.view`, `view_sha256`), not by printing the React page, using headless Chrome through @playwright/test (the same `channel: 'chrome'` the repo's Playwright tests use; bundled Chromium when present). No script, no network; A4; footer with run, report revision, full manifest hash and 'Page n of N'. A new revision is made only when the view changes (for example after a re-score). The preview shows the PDF from a blob URL because the API keeps X-Frame-Options: DENY.
decisions.why: BUILD-LOCAL 2.8 'from the same view': the same view data and hash; printing the authenticated web page would need a browser session minted by the server.

decisions.decision: The SME review sample, stage 2 reviewed scores and the 'reviewed' mark show 'Not yet sent' until work package 2.9 builds SME batches; no reviewed score is invented.
decisions.why: 07.9 SME review is 2.9.

decisions.decision: The review-item drill (diagnosis) opens for any failed benchmark episode, not only SME sample items, so an RL engineer can record a diagnosis before SME batches exist. 'Evaluator defect' is split into grader defect (fixed as a new RL Gym configuration version, no Studio item) and criterion defect (Studio inbox evaluator_defect).
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.32 and D20.

decisions.decision: Packages are write-once JSON bundles (manifests, scoring pass, score cards, report revision with the PDF hash if rendered, data card) stored under .local/rlgym/packages with their SHA-256; file names carry the content hash so a retry never overwrites.
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.17 leaves package storage and download TBD.

decisions.decision: Expected answers shown in the case and review drill-downs come from the private reference, are visible to every member of the workspace who can read the report (Viewer included, as the report design shows them), and every such view is audited (`report.expected_viewed`).
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.31/3.32 show 'Required/Expected' in the report. Open question for the owner: should Viewers see expected answers? Owner decision 22 Nov 2026: everyone in the workspace who can read the report sees expected answers, and every view stays audited (as built).

decisions.decision: The episode viewer derives the path from the sealed timeline (a node is taken when one of its tools was called); the failed node is the first failed criterion's node (skill group or the tool its rule checks), else the first refused tool call, else the last node on a timeout. Per-step timings are not recorded by the mock runner, only the episode's wall time.
decisions.why: SCREENS 3.38 leaves the path field TBD.

decisions.decision: SME decisions are accepted only from ADI Forge's client key and are final per item; rubric and environment decisions open at most one Studio inbox item per criterion or environment version (an open one is reused); 'grader is wrong' opens no Studio item: a person makes the RL Gym's fix version from the item, with the episode added as a known case (it is qualified only if its known-case tests pass, so an unchanged configuration fails honestly).
decisions.why: SPEC 07.9 and D20.

decisions.decision: A validation run (runs.purpose='validation') re-runs only the corrected task on the original episodes' cases, systems and attempts with the original environment and evaluator versions, so before/after compare per criterion; it is not a suite run and never changes the original run.
decisions.why: SPEC 07.9 step 6.

not_changed: Auth (OIDC sessions, CSRF), project isolation, immutable version binding, hidden-reference isolation and spending gates are unchanged or stricter.
No cloud deploy, no GitHub push, no email, no live model call.

note: Pending values are not consent. The build agent must not fill user approvals from inference. Dependency/default choices are proposals; live keys never belong in this file.
